findings.reason: §8 should name extending `reckon/crew/carryover_census.py` with the task-key window split rather than landing a second census, so the two data files (session-carryover.json, local-session-carryover.json) cannot drift on the same boundary.
findings.text: `read_prefix`/`charged_input` re-implement the first-turn inheritance reader that `reckon/crew/carryover_census.py` already owns (`_first_turn_input` at :120, `_dialect` at :101, `_session_id` at :112, `carryover_census()` at :221); the new script even loads that census's own output (`load_earlier_census`, :521) to corroborate itself, so the two censuses measure one quantity in two independently-maintained readers

findings.reason: §2 and §10 direct a re-run of a scanner that duplicates the death classifier instead of extending `reckon/crew/death_census.py`, so the research figure and the production classification can disagree on what a death is without any test catching it.
findings.text: `stream_facts` and `classify_attempt` (:180) re-implement `reckon/crew/death_census.py`'s `stream_facts` (:84) and `classify` (:128); the script imports only `pointer_process_alive` from the module and states in its own docstring that the terminal-attempt convention is "the convention `reckon.crew.death_census` documents"

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — the new census hides the two stream dialects, the session join and the preamble estimation behind one function (`reckon/crew/carryover_census.py:221`, `carryover_census()`), which is a small interface over substantial behaviour.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: a finding — the plan's §8 after-window census and §10 death scan each fork a stream reader that an existing module owns, instead of extending the owner.
rubric_items.reuse_search: a finding — the measurement machinery this plan adds (§8's session-inheritance census, §2/§10's death scan) re-implements stream readers that already exist as `reckon/crew/carryover_census.py` and `reckon/crew/death_census.py`, without extending them.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — the plan's additive surface is a declared read (the flight key `effective_input_window` beside `usable_input_window`) and a generalised composer (`_no_lane_reason`), each of which the plan justifies: the window key exists because the reader must take the smaller of a declared and a recorded figure, and the composer was extracted so the review the repair hold share one reason-builder rather than two parallel ones.
